items.text_th: คือเพิ่งกลับมาเล่นค่ะ ตอนล็อกอินได้สร้างบัญชีใหม่ทำยังไงให้เป็นบัญชีเก่าได้บ้างคะ
items.text_vn: Mình mới quay lại chơi. Lúc đăng nhập bị tạo tài khoản mới, làm sao để về tài khoản cũ ạ?
items.text_en: I just came back to the game. Logging in created a new account; how do I get my old account back?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi quay lại bị tạo tài khoản mới, hỏi cách lấy lại tài khoản cũ.
items.summary_en: A returning player got a new account by mistake and asks how to recover the old one.

items.text_th: เค้าแต่งสวนตลกมากไม่เอาอะไรแล้ว55555 แต่เห็นงี้น่าจะแต่งเหนื่อยอยู่นะ555555
items.text_vn: Họ trang trí vườn buồn cười quá, không cần gì nữa haha. Nhưng nhìn vậy chắc trang trí cũng mệt lắm haha.
items.text_en: Their garden decoration is hilarious. Looks like it took a lot of effort though, haha.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi khen khu vườn trang trí sáng tạo của người khác.
items.summary_en: A player admires another player's creative garden.

items.text_th: ขอความช่วยเหลือคับ ผมอยากจะย้ายจาก Steam ไป VNG แต่มันขึ้นแบบในรูป ผมไม่แน่ใจว่าต้องทำยังไง
items.text_vn: Nhờ giúp với, mình muốn chuyển từ Steam sang VNG nhưng nó hiện như trong ảnh, không biết phải làm sao.
items.text_en: Please help. I want to move from Steam to VNG but this screen appears (see photo) and I'm not sure what to do.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi Steam hỏi cách chuyển sang bản VNG khi gặp màn hình lạ.
items.summary_en: A Steam player asks how to move to VNG after hitting a confusing screen.

items.text_th: แมพไหนได้มงเยอะสุดคะ รึว่าพอๆกัน
items.text_vn: Map nào được nhiều vương miện nhất ạ, hay là như nhau?
items.text_en: Which map gives the most crowns, or are they about the same?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi hỏi map nào kiếm được nhiều vương miện nhất.
items.summary_en: A player asks which map gives the most crowns.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เคยเข้าแล้วมันออกจากระบบเอง ต้องทำยังไงคะ
items.text_vn: Trước đây vào được rồi nhưng nó tự đăng xuất, phải làm sao ạ?
items.text_en: I could log in before, but now it logs me out by itself. What should I do?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi bị tự động đăng xuất, hỏi cách xử lý.
items.summary_en: A player keeps getting logged out and asks what to do.

items.text_th: เข้าบัญชีเฟสบุ๊ด เมล ไม่ได้เลยค่ะ ใครพอทราบไหมค่ะว่าทำอย่างไรจะเข้าระบบได้
items.text_vn: Không vào được tài khoản Facebook/email luôn ạ. Ai biết cách đăng nhập không ạ?
items.text_en: I can't get into my account with Facebook or email at all. Does anyone know how to log in?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi không đăng nhập được bằng Facebook/email; người khác cũng gặp từ sau cập nhật.
items.summary_en: A player cannot log in via Facebook/email; others report the same since the update.

items.text_th: ปรึกษาหน่อยค่ะ คือเราไม่เคยมีคอมพิวเตอร์มาก่อน ไม่รู้ว่าต้องเล่นเกม play together ในคอมยังไง ถ้าเกิดไปร้านเกม จะเล่นเกม play together ในคอมร้านเกม ต้องเริ่มจากตรงไหยหรอคะ โหลดยังไง เข้าสู่ระบบยังไงคะ ?
items.text_vn: Cho mình hỏi, mình chưa từng có máy tính nên không biết chơi Play Together trên PC thế nào. Nếu đến tiệm net thì bắt đầu từ đâu, tải thế nào, đăng nhập thế nào ạ?
items.text_en: I've never had a computer. How do I play Play Together on PC? If I go to an internet cafe, where do I start, how do I download and log in?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi chưa có máy tính hỏi cách chơi bản PC ở tiệm net.
items.summary_en: A player without a PC asks how to play the PC version at an internet cafe.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: สอบถามหน่อยครับ ถ้าจะทำต้นยักษ์ควรปลูกแค่ตอนฝนตกใช่มั้ยครับ สามารถปลูกตอนฟ้าผ่าได้ไหมครับ
items.text_vn: Cho hỏi, muốn trồng cây khổng lồ thì chỉ nên trồng lúc trời mưa đúng không ạ? Trồng lúc sét đánh được không?
items.text_en: If I want to grow a giant plant, should I plant only when it rains? Can I plant during lightning?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi hỏi có nên chỉ trồng cây khổng lồ lúc mưa hay lúc có sét.
items.summary_en: A player asks whether giant plants should only be planted in rain or during lightning.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: กิจกรรมใหม่ เค้าทุบกระเป๋ากันที่ไหนหรอคะ
items.text_vn: Sự kiện mới, mọi người đập túi ở đâu vậy ạ?
items.text_en: New event: where do people smash the bags?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi hỏi chỗ đập túi trong sự kiện mới.
items.summary_en: A player asks where to smash the bags in the new event.

items.text_th: เบาบับบต้นใหญมากก
items.text_vn: Cây baobab to quá trời!
items.text_en: The baobab is huge!
items.summary_vn: Người chơi khoe cây baobab rất to.
items.summary_en: A player shows off a huge baobab.

items.text_th: ในวันที่ว่างๆ555หาอะไรปลูกไปเรื่อย
items.text_vn: Hôm rảnh rỗi haha, tìm gì đó trồng đại.
items.text_en: On a free day, haha, just planting whatever.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi chia sẻ khu vườn trồng lúc rảnh.
items.summary_en: A player shares their garden planted on a free day.

items.text_th: สอบถามค่ะ อัพเดตเกมอะไรหมดแล้ว แต่ตรงนี้กดสร้าง กดอะ...
items.text_vn: Cho hỏi, đã cập nhật game hết rồi mà chỗ này bấm tạo, bấm... không được (?) (nội dung ảnh, chỉ đọc được phần đầu)
items.text_en: I updated everything, but I can't tap 'create' here... (image post; only the start of the text was readable)
items.summary_vn: Người chơi báo không bấm được nút tạo sau khi cập nhật; admin hướng dẫn gửi hỗ trợ.
items.summary_en: A player can't tap the create button after updating; an admin pointed them to support.

items.text_th: ถ้านี่ไม่ใช่ลูกค้าที่น่าเตะออกจากโรงแรมมากที่สุด? เควสหมอนคือแบบ…นี่ฉันต้องวิ่งขึ้นลงลิฟต์เพื่อไปเอาหมอนแค่ใบเดียวให้แกจริง ๆ หรือ
items.text_vn: Nếu đây không phải vị khách đáng đuổi khỏi khách sạn nhất thì là ai? Nhiệm vụ cái gối kiểu… tôi phải chạy lên chạy xuống thang máy chỉ để lấy đúng một cái gối cho bà ta thật à?
items.text_en: If this isn't the guest who most deserves to be kicked out of the hotel... the pillow quest: I really have to run up and down the elevator for just one pillow?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi than nhiệm vụ cái gối trong sự kiện khách sạn phải chạy lên xuống quá mệt.
items.summary_en: A player complains the hotel pillow quest requires too much running up and down.

items.text_th: สปิงแดง 30 ม่วง 5 / เมล็ด 4 ต้น 🫪 มีใครใหญ่กว่านี้อีกไหม
items.text_vn: Lò xo đỏ 30, tím 5 / hạt giống 4 cây. Có ai to hơn thế này không?
items.text_en: 30 red springs and 5 purple / 4 seeds. Does anyone have a bigger one?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi khoe cây khổng lồ và hỏi có ai trồng to hơn.
items.summary_en: A player shows a giant plant and asks if anyone has a bigger one.

items.text_th: สอบถามหน่อยคะ เราเชื่อมต่อบัญชีแล้วแต่มันเด้งหลุดแล้วแบบนี้เราจะเข้ายังไงคะ

items.summary_vn: Người chơi liên kết tài khoản xong vẫn bị văng; được hướng dẫn bấm Bắt đầu tài khoản mới rồi liên kết lại.
items.summary_en: A player linked their account but is kicked out; others advised using 'start new account' and relinking.

items.text_th: ใช่ ใช่ไหมคับ … ติดยักแล้วใช่ไหมคับ 5555
items.text_vn: Đúng không… dính khổng lồ rồi đúng không haha.
items.text_en: Right? ... it turned giant, right? haha
items.summary_vn: Người chơi hào hứng hỏi cây có phải đã thành khổng lồ.
items.summary_en: A player excitedly asks if their plant became giant.

items.text_th: มีใครใหญ่กว่านี้ไหม ขอดูหน่อยค่ะ จะได้ทำใหม่
items.text_vn: Có ai to hơn thế này không, cho xem với ạ, để mình làm lại.
items.text_en: Does anyone have a bigger one? Show me so I can redo mine.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi hỏi có ai trồng cây khổng lồ to hơn.
items.summary_en: A player asks if anyone grew a bigger giant plant.
